note: Harris County GA adopted a Unified Development Code (eff. 4/1/2023) and keeps the official zoning map with Community Development, but the only published zoning map is a preliminary draft PDF built from 2009 data. The county's ArcGIS Hub (harris-county-data-hub-garc.hub.arcgis.com) returns no zoning items via its search API, and no zoning FeatureServer/MapServer was found in ArcGIS Hub or Online searches. The county's qPublic parcel viewer is a property search, not a zoning district layer. No city in the county (Hamilton, Pine Mountain, Waverly Hall, Shiloh) publishes a queryable zoning layer that was found. The River Valley RC site links no services.
